notes:
Video Studio's Recent clips section now uses a responsive thumbnail gallery. Play a clip from its still, copy its full original prompt, and scroll to load older videos. Clip length and recorded render time are shown separately. New render timings include soundtrack preparation; older clips display the timing saved by their renderer when available.

Share to socials opens the selected MP4 in File Explorer and opens the chosen YouTube, TikTok, or Facebook site. You control the upload and publication.

The sidebar update is included. Click Workbench in the header to open your projects.
